Rina P: Heads-up — after tightening the `exports` map we started seeing failures across a weird mix of environments: esbuild-based dev server (vite), Bun tests, and a Deno example. Errors vary: ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED, "does not provide an export named 'default'", and TS complaints about missing declarations.

Jonas K: Can you paste the failing import shapes or error logs?

Rina P: Short logs: 
- Vite dev: "Uncaught (in promise) TypeError: The requested module '/node_modules/@redwood/sdk-js/dist/index.js' does not provide an export named 'default'"
- Bun test: "Error: Cannot find module '@redwood/sdk-js'" when running `bun test` in the monorepo
- Deno example: import fails with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED when trying to import './package.json' subpath for metadata.

Marta S: Which publish caused it? Did we remove `./package.json` subpath or the `require` conditional? Some bundlers and runtimes (pnpm, Bun, Vite) rely on those. Also Deno sometimes imports package.json during build.

Rina P: Published 2.3.0. Exports snake: {".": {"import": "./esm/index.mjs","types":"./types/index.d.ts"},"./*":"./*"} — no `require` branch, no `./package.json`.

Jonas K: Ok — two things to do: (A) restore "./package.json": "./package.json" for tools that read it; (B) add a `require` conditional pointing to a CJS build (`./cjs/index.cjs`) so Bun/Node CJS paths and older bundlers that prefer CJS don't break. Conditional exports keep ESM for edge runtimes.

Marta S: For TypeScript, add a small `index.d.ts` that provides both `export =` and `export default` shapes. Many consumers do `import SDK from '@redwood/sdk-js'` and tsc expects a default.

Build Bot: CI flagged failing matrix jobs: vite-dev-smoke, bun-test-workspace, deno-example. See https://ci.redwood/1234/build/99

Rina P: Also note: Vite's optimized deps sometimes pre-bundle using esbuild which reads exports — missing package.json subpath causes esbuild to choke on some edge cases. Deno's lock/emit process tries to import package.json in a reference path.

Jonas K: Proposed quick patch: add "./package.json": "./package.json" and "require": "./cjs/index.cjs" under the `.` export. Add a smoke job matrix in SDK CI: run `node -r ts-node/register` require test, `bun test` fixture, `wrangler build` for workers, and a `vite dev --force` prebundle smoke.

Marta S: Also add a minimal Deno fixture that imports package.json subpath and uses `import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk-js'` to ensure the export map doesn't block Deno tooling.

CI Bot: Automated scan found 9 repos importing with `require` and 11 using default import — good to run canary.

Rina P: I'll open a patch PR restoring the compat entries and add the CI jobs. Plan: canary publish tag `canary/exports-compat`, run the failing sample jobs, then promote to stable.

Jonas K: Nice. Also add a short contributors checklist before changing exports: run pnpm, bun, deno, vite, cloudflare wrangler smoke tests. That would have caught this earlier.

Marta S: I'll draft the TS d.ts shim for default/export= interop. PR when ready.

Rina P: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/341 (WIP). Will ping when canary is up. :pray:
